fact: The assessment, based on a virtual mission of 9 to 27 August 2021, says the Ministry of Humanitarian Action asked the Prime Minister's office to let UNOPS-issued cards serve as identification for opening mobile money accounts for PACAD cash-transfer beneficiaries, because beneficiaries lack official national ID.
title: Evaluation de l'Ecosysteme des Paiements Numeriques pour les Programmes de Transferts Monetaires des Filets de Protection Sociale
